flag_definitions.FLAG_INFLATED_TURNOVER: GST reported turnover exceeds bank deposits by > 80% (possible circular billing)
flag_definitions.FLAG_UNDERREPORTED_GST: GST reported turnover is less than 60% of bank deposits (possible unfiled revenue)
flag_definitions.FLAG_GSTR_MISMATCH: Discrepancy between GSTR-1 (sales) and GSTR-3B (tax paid) exceeds 15%
flag_definitions.FLAG_CASHFLOW_DIVERGENCE: Total banking and UPI inflows diverge from reported revenue by > 40%
flag_definitions.FLAG_CHRONIC_GST_DELAY: Chronic late GST filings (> 30 days delay or regularity < 70%)
flag_definitions.FLAG_ANOMALOUS_UPI: Unusually high UPI concentration (> 70% of inflows) for a B2B sector
flag_definitions.FLAG_ARTIFICIAL_SMOOTHING: Artificially smooth inflows (CV < 0.05) with high volume (circular transactions)
flag_definitions.FLAG_THIN_FILE: No bureau track record found (thin-file borrower)
flag_definitions.FLAG_CIRCULAR_UPI: Firm is part of a circular UPI transfer ring (NetworkX cycle detection)
flag_definitions.FLAG_INVOICE_ROUND_TRIPPING: Matched high GST turnover and anomalous UPI in cycle (round-tripping)
